title: A 100-step fine-tune improves small-model structured output
friendlyTitle: A short training run made a tiny model better at valid JSON
summary: A public recipe used roughly 500 examples and 100 GRPO training steps to improve a 350-million-parameter Liquid AI model’s IFStruct score from 22.6% to 29.7%. The run targets JSON and schema compliance, fits on a free-tier 16 GB GPU and includes a reproducible notebook.
friendlySummary: Researchers improved a small model’s structured-output test score using about 500 examples and 100 training steps. The recipe can run on a free cloud GPU.
whyItMatters: Reliable structure often matters more than broad knowledge when a model feeds invoices, forms or software workflows. The result shows that narrowly targeted post-training can improve a small local model cheaply, though its final pass rate also shows substantial room for validation and retries.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Small models may become useful for focused business tasks without expensive training. Their output still needs checking because many test cases did not pass.
